data.title: Real humans. Real Content.
data.text:
Let's face it, ChatGPT writes content that is mundane, flat, and boring.

We can create hundreds of posts based on a blog, and the wonderful part about those posts is the short content is in your voice, because each post is either a direct quote or a paraphrase of what you said.

Our writers use AI for research and for editing. The research part of our work has vastly increased the writers' efficiency, and AI editing has now allowed our writers to focus on creating content rather than going back to edit. AI editing has also allowed our editors to free up their time.

items.title: Thought Leadership Content
items.text: Reports, original research, and case studies. For the B2B Commerce Trends report with Shopware, we interviewed seven firms and wrote every finding ourselves.

items.title: Blog & SEO Content
items.text: Buyers search three ways. They search "content agency near me" (SEO), they ask an AI tool a direct question about your brand (AEO), and they ask an AI tool who to hire, like "who writes case studies for commerce brands?" (GEO). We measure all three, then write for the person who reads the answer. We call that Human Read Optimization. Readers trust content that sounds like a person talking, and AI tools keep getting better at telling a person from a bot.

data.title: How It Works
data.subtitle: From first call to first draft in 1 week.

steps.text: We start with a call to learn how you talk about your business and who buys from you.
We look at your Google Analytics and Google Search Console to see what already works, and we pick topics from there.
We meet with you every other week.
A writer drafts each piece, and an editor reads it before you see it.
You approve it, and it goes live on the schedule we set together.
